contract: contract 03 §7.3 rule 6, and the store schema of library/AGENTS.md
notes: The input is one vector of 768 values, as args. args.first holds the first values. Each other value is args.fill. A value is a float or an integer.
The corpus is one file, a.md, with one chunk. The embedder is a stub that returns the vector for that chunk.
output is the bytes of the column embedding of the one row of chunks_emb: 3072 bytes. The bytes of each vector are not UTF-8, so output has the form base64.
A refused vector holds a value that has no float32. index_scope then reports the file as an error, and chunks_emb holds no row. refusal is file_error.
